g.text: Device activity and memory through each run
Each line is the mean of eight GPUs on one node · roughly two-second nvidia-smi samples
Nodes 0–1 host training; nodes 2–3 host rollout. These are GPU busy-time percentages, not MFU or achieved FLOP/s.
Reported HBM use includes allocator/cache effects. Memory drops do not directly measure optimizer-transfer volume.
